dimensions.motivation: Avoid paying again for unchanged supported facts
A later task may need a different combination or range
Limited verification displaces evidence for other imminent actions
A single source scan can acquire observations for multiple later requests
dimensions.positive_control: full source covers a later request in another group
dimensions.negative_control: rank-three demand falls outside the two cached groups

dimensions.motivation: An acquired fact may fail to affect committed values
dimensions.negative_control: correct unquoted prediction must not be marked business error

dimensions.motivation: Low-order historical coverage may omit a joint interaction
A correction must persist and improve later decisions
dimensions.negative_control: readback alone is not causal benefit

dimensions.motivation: Mixed factual and procedural summaries may lose applicability
dimensions.positive_control: verbatim history and ordinary coverage summary
dimensions.negative_control: do not hand-write erroneous model memories

dimensions.motivation: Background consolidation and delayed writes can expose stale revisions
dimensions.negative_control: unsupported transaction is not scored as model error

dimensions.motivation: Shared and private memory can deliver different support to different actors
dimensions.positive_control: same delivered evidence under same access
dimensions.negative_control: do not give one method privileged state

construction_rules: Register motivated challenge and no-fault controls before actor outputs.
Separate exact reuse, recoverable relational support and information-theoretically ambiguous states; do not demand unobservable truth.
Register all seeds and include all eligible trajectories; no failure-only filtering.
For every claimed avoidable loss, show a legal competing route and its full cost.
Split confirmation by independent history family or producer, never paraphrases of one template.
Authored controls test instrument sensitivity, not natural error prevalence.
